scope: Integration of the guided movement flows with the merged CRC decimal support and wallet statistics.
integrationChanges: Preserved main CRC/USD hundredths, migration, statistics endpoints, indexes, navigation and chart bounds.
Shared amount field exposes a decimal keyboard and two-decimal help; validation and QA assertions retain cents.
Migration recovery test now seeds a legacy edit draft directly and submits its reviewed fields; new edits remain unable to create drafts.
limits: The earlier 12 attachment scenarios and 18 review captures remain historical evidence; this integration run exercises the decimal draft/edit/attachment path and statistics drilldown.
The standard main-flow Playwright suite was updated, but not run against the shared localhost:3000 server.
The external AI provider was not called, and nothing was deployed to production.
An old unresponsive dev-server process caused the first authentication attempt to time out; restarting this worktree server allowed the full browser run to pass.
